meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 先提问弄清你想要什么，再动手改 NanoClaw：新增 Telegram、Slack 等输入渠道、接入 MCP 集成、修改路由或触发规则。改完会告诉你怎么重建、重启和验证。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 加输入渠道、改触发规则或接入集成时，它会接管。

say.text: 帮我把 Telegram 加成一个输入渠道
say.note: 它会先问接哪个 agent group、是否独立隔离

say.text: 把 Gmail 接成 MCP 工具给这个 agent group 用
say.note: 会走 /add-gmail-tool 这类现成技能

say.text: 改一下触发规则，让这个群唤醒另一个 agent group
say.note: 改动落在 wiring 的触发规则上

howto.what_en: Asks clarifying questions first, then adds or changes NanoClaw: new input channels like Telegram or Slack, MCP integrations, edits to the router or trigger rules. Afterwards it tells you how to rebuild, restart and verify.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add an input channel, change trigger rules, or add an integration to NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel
say_en.note: It asks which agent group and isolation level first

say_en.text: Wire Gmail as an MCP tool for this agent group
Change the trigger rules so this group wakes another agent group
